source.per_member_sha_note: The committed V0.1D amendment contains known post-outcome-confirmed clerical transcription errors in some per-member SHA strings. Therefore individual SHA-string mismatch alone is diagnostic and cannot reject an otherwise exact filename/row/timestamp/value reproduction. The three frozen uploaded ZIP hashes remain the authoritative original byte identities.

replay_data_boundary.warmup_source: exact audited parent December-2024 raw Min15 from Actions artifact 10419067320 plus the overlapping first 8 UTC hours contained in the frozen 2025-01 local-month file
replay_data_boundary.right_edge_policy: Preserve the historically frozen special right-edge next-open capability. Do not manufacture OHLC for the incomplete 2025-12-31 UTC daily bar. If a selected trade requires that open-only time exit, use only the exact raw 00:00 UTC open; otherwise record that the special path was unused.

acceptance.source_integrity: All 72 expected filenames must resolve from the same official MEXC bulk family. Each file must match the prospectively committed V0.1D row count and first/last open timestamps. Concatenated data must have 35040 rows, zero duplicate timestamps and zero 15m gaps per symbol.
acceptance.economic_reproduction: Frozen-rule replay must produce the exact historical trade count, exit-reason counts, symbol counts and BASE/STRESS metrics within strict floating-point tolerance. Trade-level ledger is regenerated using the committed authority execution code semantics.
acceptance.exact_ledger_fingerprint: Attempt exact historical canonical ledger fingerprint reproduction using the committed V0.1B lineage serialization. Fingerprint mismatch does not authorize any rescue or rule change; it must be separated into provenance/serialization versus economic mismatch.
acceptance.classification_exact: TFG_EXACT_TRADE_REPLAY_SOURCE_RECOVERED only if exact original source byte identity and exact historical ledger identity are both established.
acceptance.classification_semantic: TFG_SEMANTIC_REPRODUCTION_PASS_BYTE_IDENTITY_NOT_RECOVERED if official same-family source passes integrity and exact economic/trade reproduction but the expired original ZIP packaging cannot be byte-verified.
